instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme (#090A0F canvas) with yellow (#FBBF24) primary actions and teal (#34D399) badges.
Implement the exact CEO name 'Abhishek Singh Tomar' in the certificate signature block.
Provide full functionality for certificate issuance, verification by Certificate ID, PDF download/preview, and simulated/real email sending.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per workspace setup.
